build_masked_lm_task: build a MaskedLMTask to train BERT or RoBERTa style masked language models
create_masked_lm_config: create a MaskedLMConfig dataclass to configure mask probability, tokens per sample, and whole word masking
load_dataset_masked_lm: load a masked LM dataset split with token blocking, masking, and padding applied
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for inference from source tokens and lengths using build_dataset_for_inference
setup_masked_lm_task: setup a MaskedLMTask from config by loading the dictionary and initializing the task
